title: Two musical finds …
excerpt: I’m spending the last day of 2008 working on my next book (big news on that coming soon), and in the background, I’ve got some great music playing … I’m especially enjoying two brand new musical discoveries: Esther and the Protesters and The Welcome Wagon Highly recommended!
body:
I’m spending the last day of 2008 working on my next book (big news on that coming soon), and in the background, I’ve got some great music playing … I’m especially enjoying two brand new musical discoveries:

 Esther and the Protesters

and

 The Welcome Wagon

Highly recommended!
